all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Anaemia is a frequent condition during pregnancy, particularly among women in low- and middle-income countries. | Traditionally, gestational anaemia has been prevented with daily iron supplements throughout pregnancy, but adherence to this regimen due to side effects, interrupted supply of the supplements, and concerns about safety among women with an adequate iron intake, have limited the use of this intervention. | OBJECTIVES: To assess the benefits and harms of intermittent supplementation with iron alone or in combination with folic acid or other vitamins and minerals to pregnant women on neonatal and pregnancy outcomes.

all_evidence.title: Adherence to iron-folic acid supplementation among pregnant women in Ethiopia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Sendeku FW; Azeze GG; Fenta SL
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: Having secondary and above educational status of the women (AOR:2.68,95%CI:1.25, 5.74), having an early registration of antenatal care follow-up (≤16 weeks) (AOR:2.54,95%CI:1.99, 3.24), having anemia complication during current pregnancy (AOR:3.01,95%CI:1.88, 4.81), having good knowledge of iron-folic acid supplementation (AOR: 2.96, 95%CI:1.76, 4.99), having four times or more antenatal care follow up (AOR:3.66, 95%CI:2.81, 4.77), getting health education about benefit of iron and folic acid (AOR:2.62,95%CI:1.46,4.72), and having good knowledge about anemia (AOR:2.99,95%CI:2.32, 3.85) were associated risk factors for adherence to iron-folic acid supplementation.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Despite the supplementation of iron-folic acid is the recommended strategy during the antenatal period; iron deficiency anemia is the commonest hematologic complication during pregnancy. | Having secondary and above educational status of the women (AOR:2.68,95%CI:1.25, 5.74), having an early registration of antenatal care follow-up (≤16 weeks) (AOR:2.54,95%CI:1.99, 3.24), having anemia complication during current pregnancy (AOR:3.01,95%CI:1.88, 4.81), having good knowledge of iron-folic acid supplementation (AOR: 2.96, 95%CI:1.76, 4.99), having four times or more antenatal care follow up (AOR:3.66, 95%CI:2.81, 4.77), getting health education about benefit of iron and folic acid (AOR:2.62,95%CI:1.46,4.72), and having good knowledge about anemia (AOR:2.99,95%CI:2.32, 3.85) were associated risk factors for adherence to iron-folic acid supplementation. | This finding is important to design strategic policies and to prevent anemia and congenital anomaly resulted from inadequate intake of iron and folic acid.
all_evidence.key_finding: Having secondary and above educational status of the women (AOR:2.68,95%CI:1.25, 5.74), having an early registration of antenatal care follow-up (≤16 weeks) (AOR:2.54,95%CI:1.99, 3.24), having anemia complication during current pregnancy (AOR:3.01,95%CI:1.88, 4.81), having good knowledge of iron-folic acid supplementation (AOR: 2.96, 95%CI:1.76, 4.99), having four times or more antenatal care follow up (AOR:3.66, 95%CI:2.81, 4.77), getting health education about benefit of iron and folic acid (AOR:2.62,95%CI:1.46,4.72), and having good knowledge about anemia (AOR:2.99,95%CI:2.32, 3.85) were associated risk factors for adherence to iron-folic acid supplementation.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 여성의 중등 이상 학력(AOR:2.68,95%CI:1.25, 5.74), 산전관리 조기 등록(≤16주)(AOR:2.54,95%CI:1.99, 3.24), 현재 임신 중 빈혈 합병증(AOR:3.01,95%CI:1.88, 4.81), 철분-엽산 보충에 대한 좋은 지식(AOR: 2.96, 95%CI:1.76, 4.99), 산전관리 4회 이상 방문(AOR:3.66, 95%CI:2.81, 4.77), 철분과 엽산의 이점에 대한 보건교육 수령(AOR:2.62,95%CI:1.46,4.72), 빈혈에 대한 좋은 지식(AOR:2.99,95%CI:2.32, 3.85)이 철분-엽산 보충 순응도와 관련된 위험 요인이었다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Despite the supplementation of iron-folic acid is the recommended strategy during the antenatal period; iron deficiency anemia is the commonest hematologic complication during pregnancy. | Therefore, this systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to assess the level of adherence to iron-folic acid supplementation and its associated factors among pregnant women in Ethiopia. | RESULTS: Fifteen studies were included in this systematic review and meta-analysis with a total of 5808 pregnant women.

all_evidence.title: The effects of oral ferrous bisglycinate supplementation on hemoglobin and ferritin concentrations in adults and children: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
all_evidence.authors: Fischer JAJ; Cherian AM; Bone JN; Karakochuk CD
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_9: DATA ANALYSIS: Compared with other iron supplements, supplementation with ferrous bisglycinate for 4-20 weeks resulted in higher hemoglobin concentrations in pregnant women (SMD, 0.54 g/dL; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.15-0.94; P < 0.01) and fewer reported GI adverse events (IRR, 0.36; 95%CI, 0.17-0.76; P < 0.01).
all_evidence.outcome: Iron salts are commonly provided as oral supplements to prevent and treat iron deficiency, despite poor bioavailability and frequently reported adverse side effects. | Ferrous bisglycinate is a novel amino acid iron chelate that is thought to be more bioavailable and associated with fewer gastrointestinal (GI) adverse events as compared with iron salts. | OBJECTIVE: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) was conducted to evaluate the effects of ferrous bisglycinate supplementation compared with other iron supplements on hemoglobin and ferritin concentrations and GI adverse events.
all_evidence.key_finding: DATA ANALYSIS: Compared with other iron supplements, supplementation with ferrous bisglycinate for 4-20 weeks resulted in higher hemoglobin concentrations in pregnant women (SMD, 0.54 g/dL; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.15-0.94; P < 0.01) and fewer reported GI adverse events (IRR, 0.36; 95%CI, 0.17-0.76; P < 0.01).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 자료 분석: 다른 철분 보충제와 비교해 4-20주간의 페러스 비스글리시네이트 보충은 임신부에서 더 높은 헤모글로빈 농도(SMD, 0.54 g/dL; 95% 신뢰구간[CI], 0.15-0.94; P < 0.01)와 더 적은 위장관 이상반응 보고(IRR, 0.36; 95%CI, 0.17-0.76; P < 0.01)로 이어졌다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Meta-Analysis|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Systematic Review
all_evidence.population: CONTEXT: Iron deficiency and anemia have serious consequences, especially for children and pregnant women. | DATA EXTRACTION: Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted among trials of pregnant women (n = 9) and children (n = 4); pooled estimates were expressed as standardized mean differences (SMDs). | The remaining trials in other populations (n = 4; men and nonpregnant women) were qualitatively evaluated.

all_evidence.title: The Efficacy and Safety of Myo-inositol Supplementation for the Prevention of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus in Overweight and Obese Pregnant Women: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Factor PA; Corpuz H
all_evidence.venue: Journal of the ASEAN Federation of Endocrine Societies
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_14: While studies show that 4 g myo-inositol per day may decrease the incidence of GDM, pregnancy-induced hypertension and pre-term birth with no associated risk of serious adverse events, the certainty of evidence is low to very low.
all_evidence.outcome: Secondary outcomes included cesarean section rate, the incidence of pregnancy-induced hypertension, macrosomia and preterm delivery. | No adverse effects were noted. | For the secondary outcomes, standard dose myo-inositol appears to reduce the incidence of pregnancy-induced hypertension and preterm delivery, but the certainty of evidence is low to very low.
all_evidence.key_finding: While studies show that 4 g myo-inositol per day may decrease the incidence of GDM, pregnancy-induced hypertension and pre-term birth with no associated risk of serious adverse events, the certainty of evidence is low to very low.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 하루 미오이노시톨 4 g이 임신성 당뇨병, 임신성 고혈압, 조산 발생을 감소시키면서 중대한 이상반응 위험은 동반하지 않을 수 있다는 연구들이 있으나, 근거의 확실성은 낮음에서 매우 낮음 수준이다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Myo-inositol has emerged as one of the preventive therapies for the development of gestational diabetes mellitus in at-risk populations. | This systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to determine the efficacy and safety of myo-inositol in decreasing the incidence of gestational diabetes in overweight and obese pregnant women. | Inclusion criteria were randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that enrolled overweight and obese pregnant women and used myo-inositol supplementation.

all_evidence.title: The prevention of congenital anomalies with periconceptional folic acid supplementation.
all_evidence.authors: McDonald SD; Ferguson S; Tam L; Lougheed J; Walker MC
all_evidence.venue: Journal of obstetrics and gynaecology Canada : JOGC = Journal d'obstetrique et gynecologie du Canada : JOGC
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_5: Since 1998, mandatory fortification of certain foods with folate has been associated with at least a 54% reduction in the incidence of open neural tube defects, yet rates of periconceptional folic acid use remain suboptimal, especially in minority women.
all_evidence.outcome: Furthermore, a reduction in the incidence of congenital cardiac and urologic anomalies has been demonstrated in some studies following periconceptional folic acid supplementation. | There is growing evidence of a possible role of folic acid supplementation in the prevention of other congenital anomalies, including cardiac defects.
all_evidence.key_finding: Since 1998, mandatory fortification of certain foods with folate has been associated with at least a 54% reduction in the incidence of open neural tube defects, yet rates of periconceptional folic acid use remain suboptimal, especially in minority women.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 1998년 이후 특정 식품에 대한 엽산 의무 강화는 개방성 신경관결손 발생을 최소 54% 감소시킨 것과 관련이 있었으나, 임신 전후 엽산 사용률은 특히 소수인종 여성에서 여전히 미흡하다.
all_evidence.population: Since 1992, a number of national and international professional societies have released guidelines recommending folic acid supplementation of at least 0.4 mg/day for all women of childbearing age or women planning pregnancies, and 4 mg/day for women with a previous infant with a neural tube defect.

all_evidence.title: Effectiveness and safety of vitamin D in relation to bone health.
all_evidence.authors: Cranney A; Horsley T; O'Donnell S; Weiler H; Puil L; Ooi D; Atkinson S; Ward L; Moher D; Hanley D; Fang M; Yazdi F; Garritty C; Sampson M; Barrowman N; Tsertsvadze A; Mamaladze V
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_1: OBJECTIVES: To review and synthesize the literature in the following areas: the association of specific circulating 25(OH)D concentrations with bone health outcomes in children, women of reproductive age, postmenopausal women and elderly men; the effect of dietary intakes (foods fortified with vitamin D and/or vitamin D supplementation) and sun exposure on serum 25(OH)D; the effect of vitamin D on bone mineral density (BMD) and fracture or fall risk; and the identification of potential harms of vitamin D above current reference intakes.
all_evidence.outcome: OBJECTIVES: To review and synthesize the literature in the following areas: the association of specific circulating 25(OH)D concentrations with bone health outcomes in children, women of reproductive age, postmenopausal women and elderly men; the effect of dietary intakes (foods fortified with vitamin D and/or vitamin D supplementation) and sun exposure on serum 25(OH)D; the effect of vitamin D on bone mineral density (BMD) and fracture or fall risk; and the identification of potential harms of vitamin D above current reference intakes. | REVIEW METHODS: Two independent reviewers completed a multi-level process of screening the literature to identify eligible studies (title and abstract, followed by full text review, and categorization of study design per key question). | Vitamin D intake above current dietary reference intakes was not reported to be associated with an increased risk of adverse events.
all_evidence.key_finding: OBJECTIVES: To review and synthesize the literature in the following areas: the association of specific circulating 25(OH)D concentrations with bone health outcomes in children, women of reproductive age, postmenopausal women and elderly men; the effect of dietary intakes (foods fortified with vitamin D and/or vitamin D supplementation) and sun exposure on serum 25(OH)D; the effect of vitamin D on bone mineral density (BMD) and fracture or fall risk; and the identification of potential harms of vitamin D above current reference intakes.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 목적: 다음 영역의 문헌을 검토하고 종합한다: 소아, 가임기 여성, 폐경 후 여성, 노년 남성에서 특정 혈중 25(OH)D 농도와 뼈 건강 결과의 관련성; 식이 섭취(비타민 D 강화식품 및/또는 비타민 D 보충)와 햇빛 노출이 혈청 25(OH)D에 미치는 영향; 비타민 D가 골밀도(BMD)와 골절 또는 낙상 위험에 미치는 영향; 현행 기준섭취량을 초과하는 비타민 D의 잠재적 해악 규명.
all_evidence.population: There were very few studies in pregnant and lactating women, and insufficient evidence for an association between serum 25(OH)D and changes in BMD during lactation, and fair evidence of an inverse correlation with PTH.

evidence.title: The Role of Micronutrients in the Pathogenesis of Alcohol-Related Liver Disease.
evidence.authors: Nicoll R; Gerasimidis K; Forrest E
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: CONCLUSIONS: Magnesium deficiency may increase the risk of alcohol-related liver injury and adverse liver outcomes.
evidence.outcome: AIMS: Chronic alcohol consumption may result in liver injury and chronic liver disease, but other factors are likely to influence disease progression. | METHODS: Systematic integrative review of the medical literature; electronic search of MEDLINE 1950-2021; studies investigating role of any micronutrient in the acceleration of alcohol-related liver injury in humans or animals. | Observational evidence suggests a potential role of magnesium deficiency in accelerating alcohol-related liver injury with weak or negative evidence for other micronutrients.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Magnesium deficiency may increase the risk of alcohol-related liver injury and adverse liver outcomes.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 마그네슘 결핍은 알코올 관련 간손상과 불량한 간 결과의 위험을 증가시킬 수 있다.
evidence.population: AIMS: Chronic alcohol consumption may result in liver injury and chronic liver disease, but other factors are likely to influence disease progression. | Malnutrition, specifically micronutrient deficiency, is frequently associated with both alcohol use disorder and chronic liver disease. | We hypothesize that micronutrient deficiencies may affect the progression of liver disease in this population.

evidence.title: Effects of oral branched-chain amino acid granules on event-free survival in patients with liver cirrhosis.
evidence.authors: Muto Y; Sato S; Watanabe A; Moriwaki H; Suzuki K; Kato A; Kato M; Nakamura T; Higuchi K; Nishiguchi S; Kumada H; Long-Term Survival Study Group
evidence.venue: Clinical gastroenterology and hepatology : the official clinical practice journal of the American Gastroenterological Association
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: RESULTS: The incidence of events comprising the primary end point significantly decreased in the BCAA group as compared with the diet group (hazard ratio, 0.67; 95% confidence interval, 0.49-0.93; P = .015; median observation period, 445 days).
evidence.outcome: The primary end point was a composite of death by any cause, development of liver cancer, rupture of esophageal varices, or progress of hepatic failure (event-free survival).
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: The incidence of events comprising the primary end point significantly decreased in the BCAA group as compared with the diet group (hazard ratio, 0.67; 95% confidence interval, 0.49-0.93; P = .015; median observation period, 445 days).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 일차 평가변수를 구성하는 사건의 발생은 식이군과 비교해 분지쇄아미노산군에서 유의하게 감소했다(위험비, 0.67; 95% 신뢰구간, 0.49-0.93; P = .015; 중앙 관찰기간, 445일).
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial|Journal Article|Multicenter Study|Randomized Controlled Trial
evidence.population: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Nutritional intervention with branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) is reported to increase serum albumin concentration in patients with decompensated cirrhosis. | The present study aimed to test possibilities of improving survival of patients with decompensated cirrhosis by using a BCAA preparation that is suitable for long-term oral administration. | METHODS: A multicenter, randomized, and nutrient intake-controlled trial on the comparative effects of BCAA orally administered at 12 g/day for 2 years versus diet therapy with defined daily food intake (1.0-1.4 g protein kg(-1) day(-1) including BCAA preparation and 25-35 kcal kg(-1) day(-1)) was conducted in 646 patients with decompensated cirrhosis.

evidence.title: Effect of Green Tea Supplements on Liver Enzyme Elevation: Results from a Randomized Intervention Study in the United States.
evidence.authors: Yu Z; Samavat H; Dostal AM; Wang R; Torkelson CJ; Yang CS; Butler LM; Kensler TW; Wu AH; Kurzer MS; Yuan JM
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_3: We examined the potential effects of a high, sustained oral dose of green tea extract (GTE) on liver injury measures in a randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blinded phase II clinical trial, which enrolled 1,075 women with the original aim to assess the effect of daily GTE consumption for 12 months on biomarkers of breast cancer risk.
evidence.outcome: Liver injury effects of green tea-based products have been reported in sporadic case reports. | However, no study has examined systematically such adverse effects in an unbiased manner. | We examined the potential effects of a high, sustained oral dose of green tea extract (GTE) on liver injury measures in a randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blinded phase II clinical trial, which enrolled 1,075 women with the original aim to assess the effect of daily GTE consumption for 12 months on biomarkers of breast cancer risk.
evidence.key_finding: We examined the potential effects of a high, sustained oral dose of green tea extract (GTE) on liver injury measures in a randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blinded phase II clinical trial, which enrolled 1,075 women with the original aim to assess the effect of daily GTE consumption for 12 months on biomarkers of breast cancer risk.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 우리는 무작위 위약대조 이중맹검 II상 임상시험에서 고용량 녹차추출물(GTE)을 지속적으로 경구 투여했을 때 간손상 지표에 미치는 잠재적 영향을 조사했다. 이 시험은 원래 매일의 녹차추출물 섭취가 12개월간 유방암 위험 바이오마커에 미치는 영향을 평가할 목적으로 여성 1,075명을 등록했다.
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial, Phase II|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial
evidence.population: Liver injury effects of green tea-based products have been reported in sporadic case reports. | We examined the potential effects of a high, sustained oral dose of green tea extract (GTE) on liver injury measures in a randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blinded phase II clinical trial, which enrolled 1,075 women with the original aim to assess the effect of daily GTE consumption for 12 months on biomarkers of breast cancer risk. | The current analysis examined the effect of GTE consumption on liver injury in 1,021 participants (513 in GTE and 508 in placebo arm) with normal baseline levels of liver enzymes.

all_evidence.outcome: We systematically searched PubMed, Web of Science, EMBASE, and Cochrane Library for randomized controlled trials that compared the different treatments for HE including probiotics, symbiotics, and fecal microbiota transplant (FMT). | Probiotics, synbiotics and FMT significantly reversed minimal HE (MHE) (OR: 0.41, 95% CI: 0.19-0.90, P = 0.03), reduced overt HE (OHE) development (OR, 0.41; 95% CI: 0.28-0.61 P < 0.00001)and the frequency of serious adverse events(SAEs) (OR:0.14, 95% CI: 0.04-0.47, P = 0.001), meanwhile decreased ammonia levels (WMD: -9.26, 95% CI: -16.92 to -1.61; P = 0.02), NCT level (MD = -4.41, 95% CI: -0.87 to -0.22, P = 0.04) and hospitalization rates (OR, 0.38; 95% CI: 0.19-0.79, P = 0.009) compared with placebo/no treatment. | Finally, we conclude that microbiome therapies were more effective in improving MHE and preventing progression to OHE, reducing the frequency of SAEs, and decreasing ammonia levels, NCT level, and hospitalization rates when compared to placebo/no treatment.

evidence.title: Probiotics for people with hepatic encephalopathy.
evidence.authors: Dalal R; McGee RG; Riordan SM; Webster AC
evidence.venue: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_23: There were no reports of septicaemia attributable to probiotic in any trial.When probiotics were compared with lactulose, the effects on all-cause mortality were uncertain (2 trials; 200 participants; RR 5.00, 95% CI 0.25 to 102.00; very low-quality evidence); lack of recovery (7 trials; 430 participants; RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.85 to 1.21; very low-quality evidence); adverse events considering the development of overt hepatic encephalopathy (6 trials; 420 participants; RR 1.17, 95% CI 0.63 to 2.17; very low-quality evidence); hospitalisation (1 trial; 80 participants; RR 0.33, 95% CI 0.04 to 3.07; very low-quality evidence); intolerance leading to discontinuation (3 trials; 220 participants; RR 0.35, 95% CI 0.08 to 1.43; very low-quality evidence); change of/or withdrawal from treatment (7 trials; 490 participants; RR 1.27, 95% CI 0.88 to 1.82; very low-quality evidence); quality of life (results not meta-analysed; 1 trial; 69 participants); and plasma ammonia concentration overall (6 trials; 325 participants; MD -2.93 μmol/L, 95% CI -9.36 to 3.50; very low-quality evidence).
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Hepatic encephalopathy is a disorder of brain function as a result of liver failure or portosystemic shunt or both. | We classified 19 of the 21 trials at high risk of bias.We found no effect on all-cause mortality when probiotics were compared with placebo or no treatment (7 trials; 404 participants; RR 0.58, 95% CI 0.23 to 1.44; low-quality evidence). | Adverse events were lower for participants treated with probiotic than with no intervention when considering the development of overt hepatic encephalopathy (10 trials; 585 participants; RR 0.29, 95% CI 0.16 to 0.51; low-quality evidence), but effects on hospitalisation and change of/or withdrawal from treatment were uncertain (hospitalisation: 3 trials, 163 participants; RR 0.67, 95% CI 0.11 to 4.00; very low-quality evidence; change of/or withdrawal from treatment: 9 trials, 551 participants; RR 0.70, 95% CI 0.46 to 1.07; very low-quality evidence).
evidence.key_finding: There were no reports of septicaemia attributable to probiotic in any trial.When probiotics were compared with lactulose, the effects on all-cause mortality were uncertain (2 trials; 200 participants; RR 5.00, 95% CI 0.25 to 102.00; very low-quality evidence); lack of recovery (7 trials; 430 participants; RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.85 to 1.21; very low-quality evidence); adverse events considering the development of overt hepatic encephalopathy (6 trials; 420 participants; RR 1.17, 95% CI 0.63 to 2.17; very low-quality evidence); hospitalisation (1 trial; 80 participants; RR 0.33, 95% CI 0.04 to 3.07; very low-quality evidence); intolerance leading to discontinuation (3 trials; 220 participants; RR 0.35, 95% CI 0.08 to 1.43; very low-quality evidence); change of/or withdrawal from treatment (7 trials; 490 participants; RR 1.27, 95% CI 0.88 to 1.82; very low-quality evidence); quality of life (results not meta-analysed; 1 trial; 69 participants); and plasma ammonia concentration overall (6 trials; 325 participants; MD -2.93 μmol/L, 95% CI -9.36 to 3.50; very low-quality evidence).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 어떤 시험에서도 프로바이오틱스에 기인한 패혈증 보고는 없었다. 프로바이오틱스를 락툴로스와 비교했을 때 전체 원인 사망(2개 시험; 참가자 200명; RR 5.00, 95% CI 0.25 to 102.00; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 회복 실패(7개 시험; 참가자 430명; RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.85 to 1.21; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 현성 간성뇌증 발생으로 본 이상반응(6개 시험; 참가자 420명; RR 1.17, 95% CI 0.63 to 2.17; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 입원(1개 시험; 참가자 80명; RR 0.33, 95% CI 0.04 to 3.07; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 불내성으로 인한 중단(3개 시험; 참가자 220명; RR 0.35, 95% CI 0.08 to 1.43; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 치료 변경 또는 중도 탈락(7개 시험; 참가자 490명; RR 1.27, 95% CI 0.88 to 1.82; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 삶의 질(메타분석하지 않음; 1개 시험; 참가자 69명), 전체 혈장 암모니아 농도(6개 시험; 참가자 325명; MD -2.93 μmol/L, 95% CI -9.36 to 3.50; 매우 낮은 질 근거)에 대한 효과는 불확실했다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Hepatic encephalopathy is a disorder of brain function as a result of liver failure or portosystemic shunt or both. | Both hepatic encephalopathy (clinically overt) and minimal hepatic encephalopathy (not clinically overt) significantly impair patient's quality of life and daily functioning, and represent a significant burden on healthcare resources. | OBJECTIVES: To determine the beneficial and harmful effects of probiotics in any dosage, compared with placebo or no intervention, or with any other treatment for people with any grade of acute or chronic hepatic encephalopathy.

evidence.title: Effects of branched chain amino acid supplementation on patient care outcomes in adults and children with liver cirrhosis: A systematic review.
evidence.authors: Ooi PH; Gilmour SM; Yap J; Mager DR
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_2: Low serum concentrations of branched chain amino acids (BCAA) in the presence of elevated aromatic acid concentrations is commonly observed in adult and children with liver cirrhosis and is associated with malnutrition and other adverse patient outcomes.
evidence.outcome: Low serum concentrations of branched chain amino acids (BCAA) in the presence of elevated aromatic acid concentrations is commonly observed in adult and children with liver cirrhosis and is associated with malnutrition and other adverse patient outcomes. | The purpose of this review was to critically evaluate the literature regarding the impact of BCAA supplementation related to changes in body composition, muscle strength, liver biomarkers, medical and hepatic complications (hepatic encephalopathy (HE), ascites, edema) and patient care outcomes (event free survival, health related quality of life, length of hospitalization).
evidence.key_finding: Low serum concentrations of branched chain amino acids (BCAA) in the presence of elevated aromatic acid concentrations is commonly observed in adult and children with liver cirrhosis and is associated with malnutrition and other adverse patient outcomes.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 방향족 아미노산 농도가 상승한 상태에서 혈청 분지쇄아미노산(BCAA) 농도가 낮은 소견은 간경변이 있는 성인과 소아에서 흔히 관찰되며 영양불량 및 기타 불량한 환자 결과와 관련이 있다.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Malnutrition is highly prevalent in chronic liver disease (CLD) due to alterations in nutrient utilization, malabsorption and poor intake. | Low serum concentrations of branched chain amino acids (BCAA) in the presence of elevated aromatic acid concentrations is commonly observed in adult and children with liver cirrhosis and is associated with malnutrition and other adverse patient outcomes. | The purpose of this review was to critically evaluate the literature regarding the impact of BCAA supplementation related to changes in body composition, muscle strength, liver biomarkers, medical and hepatic complications (hepatic encephalopathy (HE), ascites, edema) and patient care outcomes (event free survival, health related quality of life, length of hospitalization).

all_evidence.title: Profile of herbal and dietary supplements induced liver injury in Latin America: A systematic review of published reports.
all_evidence.authors: Santos G; Gasca J; Parana R; Nunes V; Schinnoni M; Medina-Caliz I; Cabello MR; Lucena MI; Andrade RJ
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_2: We have undertaken a systematic review of published case reports and case series from LA from 1976 to 2020 to describe the clinical features of HDS related hepatotoxicity in this region.
all_evidence.outcome: Hepatotoxicity related to HDS is a growing global health issue. | We have undertaken a systematic review of published case reports and case series from LA from 1976 to 2020 to describe the clinical features of HDS related hepatotoxicity in this region. | The clinical characteristics of HDS hepatotoxicity in our study were compared to those of other studies in the USA, Europe and China showing a similar signature with predominance of young females, hepatocellular damage, a high rate of ALF and mortality, more frequent inadvertent re-challenge and chronic damage.
all_evidence.key_finding: We have undertaken a systematic review of published case reports and case series from LA from 1976 to 2020 to describe the clinical features of HDS related hepatotoxicity in this region.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 우리는 이 지역에서 허브·식이보충제 관련 간독성의 임상적 특징을 기술하기 위해 1976년부터 2020년까지 라틴아메리카에서 발표된 증례보고와 증례군에 대한 체계적 고찰을 수행했다.

all_evidence.title: Acute liver injury following turmeric use in Tuscany: An analysis of the Italian Phytovigilance database and systematic review of case reports.
all_evidence.authors: Lombardi N; Crescioli G; Maggini V; Ippoliti I; Menniti-Ippolito F; Gallo E; Brilli V; Lanzi C; Mannaioni G; Firenzuoli F; Vannacci A
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_2: The aim of this research was to describe the Tuscan (Italy) cases of acute hepatitis and to compare them with similar cases of hepatotoxicity published in the literature by performing a systematic review.
all_evidence.outcome: The aim of this research was to describe the Tuscan (Italy) cases of acute hepatitis and to compare them with similar cases of hepatotoxicity published in the literature by performing a systematic review. | In all cases, hepatotoxicity was associated with Curcuma longa formulations with high bioavailability and high dosage of curcumin/curcuminoids. | CONCLUSIONS: Within the frame of poorly controlled and regulated products, such as dietary supplements, the evaluation of Italian cases of Curcuma longa-induced acute hepatitis and the systematic review of literature confirmed the association between Curcuma longa and liver injury.
all_evidence.key_finding: The aim of this research was to describe the Tuscan (Italy) cases of acute hepatitis and to compare them with similar cases of hepatotoxicity published in the literature by performing a systematic review.

evidence.title: The Role of Micronutrients in the Pathogenesis of Alcohol-Related Liver Disease.
evidence.authors: Nicoll R; Gerasimidis K; Forrest E
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: CONCLUSIONS: Magnesium deficiency may increase the risk of alcohol-related liver injury and adverse liver outcomes.
evidence.outcome: AIMS: Chronic alcohol consumption may result in liver injury and chronic liver disease, but other factors are likely to influence disease progression. | METHODS: Systematic integrative review of the medical literature; electronic search of MEDLINE 1950-2021; studies investigating role of any micronutrient in the acceleration of alcohol-related liver injury in humans or animals. | Observational evidence suggests a potential role of magnesium deficiency in accelerating alcohol-related liver injury with weak or negative evidence for other micronutrients.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: Magnesium deficiency may increase the risk of alcohol-related liver injury and adverse liver outcomes.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 마그네슘 결핍은 알코올 관련 간손상과 불량한 간 결과의 위험을 증가시킬 수 있다.
evidence.population: AIMS: Chronic alcohol consumption may result in liver injury and chronic liver disease, but other factors are likely to influence disease progression. | Malnutrition, specifically micronutrient deficiency, is frequently associated with both alcohol use disorder and chronic liver disease. | We hypothesize that micronutrient deficiencies may affect the progression of liver disease in this population.

all_evidence.title: Probiotics can improve the clinical outcomes of hepatic encephalopathy: An update meta-analysis.
all_evidence.authors: Zhao LN; Yu T; Lan SY; Hou JT; Zhang ZZ; Wang SS; Liu FB
all_evidence.venue: Clinics and research in hepatology and gastroenterology
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: Reduction of severe adverse events, defined as minimal HE developing into overt HE, hospitalizations, infections or unrelated emergency room (ER) visits, was observed in HE with probiotics (RR 0.59; 95% CI 0.39-0.90).
all_evidence.outcome: Reduction of severe adverse events, defined as minimal HE developing into overt HE, hospitalizations, infections or unrelated emergency room (ER) visits, was observed in HE with probiotics (RR 0.59; 95% CI 0.39-0.90). | CONCLUSION: Our pooled results indicated that probiotics was associated with improvement of minimal HE, prophylaxis of overt HE, and reduction of SIP score and severe adverse events.
all_evidence.key_finding: Reduction of severe adverse events, defined as minimal HE developing into overt HE, hospitalizations, infections or unrelated emergency room (ER) visits, was observed in HE with probiotics (RR 0.59; 95% CI 0.39-0.90).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 최소 간성뇌증이 현성 간성뇌증으로 진행하는 것, 입원, 감염, 무관한 응급실(ER) 방문으로 정의한 중대한 이상반응의 감소가 프로바이오틱스를 사용한 간성뇌증에서 관찰됐다(RR 0.59; 95% CI 0.39-0.90).
all_evidence.population: INTRODUCTION: Although the efficacy of probiotics has been extensively studied in hepatic encephalopathy (HE), the results remain controversial.

all_evidence.title: Probiotics for people with hepatic encephalopathy.
all_evidence.authors: Dalal R; McGee RG; Riordan SM; Webster AC
all_evidence.venue: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_23: There were no reports of septicaemia attributable to probiotic in any trial.When probiotics were compared with lactulose, the effects on all-cause mortality were uncertain (2 trials; 200 participants; RR 5.00, 95% CI 0.25 to 102.00; very low-quality evidence); lack of recovery (7 trials; 430 participants; RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.85 to 1.21; very low-quality evidence); adverse events considering the development of overt hepatic encephalopathy (6 trials; 420 participants; RR 1.17, 95% CI 0.63 to 2.17; very low-quality evidence); hospitalisation (1 trial; 80 participants; RR 0.33, 95% CI 0.04 to 3.07; very low-quality evidence); intolerance leading to discontinuation (3 trials; 220 participants; RR 0.35, 95% CI 0.08 to 1.43; very low-quality evidence); change of/or withdrawal from treatment (7 trials; 490 participants; RR 1.27, 95% CI 0.88 to 1.82; very low-quality evidence); quality of life (results not meta-analysed; 1 trial; 69 participants); and plasma ammonia concentration overall (6 trials; 325 participants; MD -2.93 μmol/L, 95% CI -9.36 to 3.50; very low-quality evidence).
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Hepatic encephalopathy is a disorder of brain function as a result of liver failure or portosystemic shunt or both. | We classified 19 of the 21 trials at high risk of bias.We found no effect on all-cause mortality when probiotics were compared with placebo or no treatment (7 trials; 404 participants; RR 0.58, 95% CI 0.23 to 1.44; low-quality evidence). | Adverse events were lower for participants treated with probiotic than with no intervention when considering the development of overt hepatic encephalopathy (10 trials; 585 participants; RR 0.29, 95% CI 0.16 to 0.51; low-quality evidence), but effects on hospitalisation and change of/or withdrawal from treatment were uncertain (hospitalisation: 3 trials, 163 participants; RR 0.67, 95% CI 0.11 to 4.00; very low-quality evidence; change of/or withdrawal from treatment: 9 trials, 551 participants; RR 0.70, 95% CI 0.46 to 1.07; very low-quality evidence).
all_evidence.key_finding: There were no reports of septicaemia attributable to probiotic in any trial.When probiotics were compared with lactulose, the effects on all-cause mortality were uncertain (2 trials; 200 participants; RR 5.00, 95% CI 0.25 to 102.00; very low-quality evidence); lack of recovery (7 trials; 430 participants; RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.85 to 1.21; very low-quality evidence); adverse events considering the development of overt hepatic encephalopathy (6 trials; 420 participants; RR 1.17, 95% CI 0.63 to 2.17; very low-quality evidence); hospitalisation (1 trial; 80 participants; RR 0.33, 95% CI 0.04 to 3.07; very low-quality evidence); intolerance leading to discontinuation (3 trials; 220 participants; RR 0.35, 95% CI 0.08 to 1.43; very low-quality evidence); change of/or withdrawal from treatment (7 trials; 490 participants; RR 1.27, 95% CI 0.88 to 1.82; very low-quality evidence); quality of life (results not meta-analysed; 1 trial; 69 participants); and plasma ammonia concentration overall (6 trials; 325 participants; MD -2.93 μmol/L, 95% CI -9.36 to 3.50; very low-quality evidence).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 어떤 시험에서도 프로바이오틱스에 기인한 패혈증 보고는 없었다. 프로바이오틱스를 락툴로스와 비교했을 때 전체 원인 사망(2개 시험; 참가자 200명; RR 5.00, 95% CI 0.25 to 102.00; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 회복 실패(7개 시험; 참가자 430명; RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.85 to 1.21; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 현성 간성뇌증 발생으로 본 이상반응(6개 시험; 참가자 420명; RR 1.17, 95% CI 0.63 to 2.17; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 입원(1개 시험; 참가자 80명; RR 0.33, 95% CI 0.04 to 3.07; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 불내성으로 인한 중단(3개 시험; 참가자 220명; RR 0.35, 95% CI 0.08 to 1.43; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 치료 변경 또는 중도 탈락(7개 시험; 참가자 490명; RR 1.27, 95% CI 0.88 to 1.82; 매우 낮은 질 근거), 삶의 질(메타분석하지 않음; 1개 시험; 참가자 69명), 전체 혈장 암모니아 농도(6개 시험; 참가자 325명; MD -2.93 μmol/L, 95% CI -9.36 to 3.50; 매우 낮은 질 근거)에 대한 효과는 불확실했다.
all_evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Hepatic encephalopathy is a disorder of brain function as a result of liver failure or portosystemic shunt or both. | Both hepatic encephalopathy (clinically overt) and minimal hepatic encephalopathy (not clinically overt) significantly impair patient's quality of life and daily functioning, and represent a significant burden on healthcare resources. | OBJECTIVES: To determine the beneficial and harmful effects of probiotics in any dosage, compared with placebo or no intervention, or with any other treatment for people with any grade of acute or chronic hepatic encephalopathy.

all_evidence.title: Effects of branched chain amino acid supplementation on patient care outcomes in adults and children with liver cirrhosis: A systematic review.

all_evidence.outcome: Low serum concentrations of branched chain amino acids (BCAA) in the presence of elevated aromatic acid concentrations is commonly observed in adult and children with liver cirrhosis and is associated with malnutrition and other adverse patient outcomes. | The purpose of this review was to critically evaluate the literature regarding the impact of BCAA supplementation related to changes in body composition, muscle strength, liver biomarkers, medical and hepatic complications (hepatic encephalopathy (HE), ascites, edema) and patient care outcomes (event free survival, health related quality of life, length of hospitalization).

all_evidence.title: The landscape of hepatobiliary adverse reactions across 53 herbal and dietary supplements reveals immune-mediated injury as a common cause of hepatitis.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_4: Outstandingly, females developed HILI more rapidly (p = 0.018) and the time to recovery was significantly increased (p = 0.0153). > 90% of reported cases were severe and half of HDS products caused acute liver failure (ALF) requiring liver transplantation or resulted in fatal outcomes.

all_evidence.outcome: We systematically searched PubMed, Web of Science, EMBASE, and Cochrane Library for randomized controlled trials that compared the different treatments for HE including probiotics, symbiotics, and fecal microbiota transplant (FMT). | Probiotics, synbiotics and FMT significantly reversed minimal HE (MHE) (OR: 0.41, 95% CI: 0.19-0.90, P = 0.03), reduced overt HE (OHE) development (OR, 0.41; 95% CI: 0.28-0.61 P < 0.00001)and the frequency of serious adverse events(SAEs) (OR:0.14, 95% CI: 0.04-0.47, P = 0.001), meanwhile decreased ammonia levels (WMD: -9.26, 95% CI: -16.92 to -1.61; P = 0.02), NCT level (MD = -4.41, 95% CI: -0.87 to -0.22, P = 0.04) and hospitalization rates (OR, 0.38; 95% CI: 0.19-0.79, P = 0.009) compared with placebo/no treatment. | Finally, we conclude that microbiome therapies were more effective in improving MHE and preventing progression to OHE, reducing the frequency of SAEs, and decreasing ammonia levels, NCT level, and hospitalization rates when compared to placebo/no treatment.

evidence.title: Anticoagulation control with daily low-dose vitamin k to reduce clinically adverse outcomes and international normalized ratio variability: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Lam J; Schulman S; Witt DM; Vandvik PO; Qayyum F; Holbrook AM
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis, despite the few studies and overall low quality, suggests no beneficial role of low-dose (100 to 200 μg) vitamin K supplementation on the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events in patients taking VKAs, despite a small improvement of the TTR.
evidence.outcome: STUDY OBJECTIVES: Difficulties managing warfarin therapy have led to speculation that daily supplementation with a low dose of vitamin K might improve anticoagulation control and clinical outcomes. | Thus we sought to review the available medical literature systematically examining the effectiveness of low-dose vitamin K supplementation for the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events due to vitamin K antagonist (VKA) use and for stabilization of the international normalized ratio (INR). | We evaluated the outcomes of hemorrhage, thromboembolic events, and percentage of time in therapeutic range (TTR) of INRs by using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation system for rating quality of evidence in the abstracted studies.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis, despite the few studies and overall low quality, suggests no beneficial role of low-dose (100 to 200 μg) vitamin K supplementation on the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events in patients taking VKAs, despite a small improvement of the TTR.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 메타분석은 포함된 연구가 적고 전반적 질이 낮음에도, 치료범위내시간(TTR)의 소폭 개선에도 불구하고 비타민 K 길항제를 복용하는 환자에서 저용량(100 to 200 μg) 비타민 K 보충이 임상적으로 유의한 이상반응 감소에 유익한 역할을 하지 않음을 시사한다.
evidence.population: STUDY OBJECTIVES: Difficulties managing warfarin therapy have led to speculation that daily supplementation with a low dose of vitamin K might improve anticoagulation control and clinical outcomes.

evidence.title: Effect of vitamin E supplementation on vitamin K status in adults with normal coagulation status.

evidence.venue: The American journal of clinical nutrition
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: CONCLUSIONS: High-dose vitamin E supplementation increased PIVKA-II in adults not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy.

evidence.title: Anticoagulation control with daily low-dose vitamin k to reduce clinically adverse outcomes and international normalized ratio variability: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis, despite the few studies and overall low quality, suggests no beneficial role of low-dose (100 to 200 μg) vitamin K supplementation on the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events in patients taking VKAs, despite a small improvement of the TTR.
evidence.outcome: STUDY OBJECTIVES: Difficulties managing warfarin therapy have led to speculation that daily supplementation with a low dose of vitamin K might improve anticoagulation control and clinical outcomes. | Thus we sought to review the available medical literature systematically examining the effectiveness of low-dose vitamin K supplementation for the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events due to vitamin K antagonist (VKA) use and for stabilization of the international normalized ratio (INR). | We evaluated the outcomes of hemorrhage, thromboembolic events, and percentage of time in therapeutic range (TTR) of INRs by using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation system for rating quality of evidence in the abstracted studies.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis, despite the few studies and overall low quality, suggests no beneficial role of low-dose (100 to 200 μg) vitamin K supplementation on the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events in patients taking VKAs, despite a small improvement of the TTR.

evidence.title: Anticoagulation control with daily low-dose vitamin k to reduce clinically adverse outcomes and international normalized ratio variability: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Lam J; Schulman S; Witt DM; Vandvik PO; Qayyum F; Holbrook AM
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis, despite the few studies and overall low quality, suggests no beneficial role of low-dose (100 to 200 μg) vitamin K supplementation on the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events in patients taking VKAs, despite a small improvement of the TTR.
evidence.outcome: STUDY OBJECTIVES: Difficulties managing warfarin therapy have led to speculation that daily supplementation with a low dose of vitamin K might improve anticoagulation control and clinical outcomes. | Thus we sought to review the available medical literature systematically examining the effectiveness of low-dose vitamin K supplementation for the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events due to vitamin K antagonist (VKA) use and for stabilization of the international normalized ratio (INR). | We evaluated the outcomes of hemorrhage, thromboembolic events, and percentage of time in therapeutic range (TTR) of INRs by using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation system for rating quality of evidence in the abstracted studies.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis, despite the few studies and overall low quality, suggests no beneficial role of low-dose (100 to 200 μg) vitamin K supplementation on the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events in patients taking VKAs, despite a small improvement of the TTR.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 메타분석은 포함된 연구가 적고 전반적 질이 낮음에도, 치료범위내시간(TTR)의 소폭 개선에도 불구하고 비타민 K 길항제를 복용하는 환자에서 저용량(100 to 200 μg) 비타민 K 보충이 임상적으로 유의한 이상반응 감소에 유익한 역할을 하지 않음을 시사한다.
evidence.population: STUDY OBJECTIVES: Difficulties managing warfarin therapy have led to speculation that daily supplementation with a low dose of vitamin K might improve anticoagulation control and clinical outcomes.

evidence.title: Effect of vitamin E supplementation on vitamin K status in adults with normal coagulation status.
evidence.authors: Booth SL; Golly I; Sacheck JM; Roubenoff R; Dallal GE; Hamada K; Blumberg JB
evidence.venue: The American journal of clinical nutrition
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: CONCLUSIONS: High-dose vitamin E supplementation increased PIVKA-II in adults not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Cases of enhanced anticoagulant effect in response to high-dose vitamin E supplementation have been reported among patients taking oral anticoagulants. | Although a vitamin E-vitamin K interaction was proposed to underlie this effect, it has not been systematically investigated in adults with normal baseline coagulation status. | OBJECTIVE: The objective was to study the effect of 12 wk of supplementation with 1000 IU RRR-alpha-tocopherol/d on biochemical measures of vitamin K status in men and women not taking oral anticoagulants.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: High-dose vitamin E supplementation increased PIVKA-II in adults not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 고용량 비타민 E 보충은 경구 항응고요법을 받지 않는 성인에서 PIVKA-II를 증가시켰다.
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Research Support, U.S. Gov't, Non-P.H.S.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Cases of enhanced anticoagulant effect in response to high-dose vitamin E supplementation have been reported among patients taking oral anticoagulants. | OBJECTIVE: The objective was to study the effect of 12 wk of supplementation with 1000 IU RRR-alpha-tocopherol/d on biochemical measures of vitamin K status in men and women not taking oral anticoagulants. | CONCLUSIONS: High-dose vitamin E supplementation increased PIVKA-II in adults not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy.

evidence.title: Concurrent Use of Prescription Drugs and Herbal Medicinal Products in Older Adults: A Systematic Review.
evidence.authors: Agbabiaka TB; Wider B; Watson LK; Goodman C
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_1: BACKGROUND: The use of herbal medicinal products (HMPs) is common among older adults; however, little is known about concurrent use with prescription drugs, as well as potential interactions associated with such combinations.

evidence.key_finding: BACKGROUND: The use of herbal medicinal products (HMPs) is common among older adults; however, little is known about concurrent use with prescription drugs, as well as potential interactions associated with such combinations.

evidence.title: ASSOCIATION BETWEEN ORAL IRON SUPPLEMENTATION AND RETINAL OR SUBRETINAL HEMORRHAGE IN THE COMPARISON OF AGE-RELATED MACULAR DEGENERATION TREATMENT TRIALS.
evidence.authors: Song D; Ying GS; Dunaief JL; Bhuyan R; Li Y; Maguire MG; Grunwald JE; Daniel E; Hagstrom S; Martin DF; Comparison of Age-Related Macular Degeneration Treatment Trial Research Group
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: Iron use was associated with hemorrhage in participants with hypertension (adjusted odds ratio = 1.87, P = 0.006) but not without hypertension.
evidence.outcome: PURPOSE: Because patients often take iron supplements without medical indication, and iron can accumulate in vascular endothelial cells, the authors evaluated the association of oral iron supplementation with retinal/subretinal hemorrhage in patients with neovascular age-related macular degeneration. | Trained readers evaluated retinal/subretinal hemorrhage in baseline fundus photographs. | Adjusted odds ratios from multivariate logistic regression models assessed the association between iron use and baseline hemorrhage adjusted by age, sex, smoking, hypertension, anemia, and use of antiplatelet/anticoagulant drugs.
evidence.key_finding: Iron use was associated with hemorrhage in participants with hypertension (adjusted odds ratio = 1.87, P = 0.006) but not without hypertension.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 철분 사용은 고혈압이 있는 참가자에서 출혈과 관련이 있었으나(보정 오즈비 = 1.87, P = 0.006) 고혈압이 없는 경우에는 관련이 없었다.
evidence.population: Adjusted odds ratios from multivariate logistic regression models assessed the association between iron use and baseline hemorrhage adjusted by age, sex, smoking, hypertension, anemia, and use of antiplatelet/anticoagulant drugs.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_7: Iron use was associated with hemorrhage in participants with hypertension (adjusted odds ratio = 1.87, P = 0.006) but not without hypertension.

evidence.title: Anticoagulation control with daily low-dose vitamin k to reduce clinically adverse outcomes and international normalized ratio variability: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Lam J; Schulman S; Witt DM; Vandvik PO; Qayyum F; Holbrook AM
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis, despite the few studies and overall low quality, suggests no beneficial role of low-dose (100 to 200 μg) vitamin K supplementation on the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events in patients taking VKAs, despite a small improvement of the TTR.
evidence.outcome: STUDY OBJECTIVES: Difficulties managing warfarin therapy have led to speculation that daily supplementation with a low dose of vitamin K might improve anticoagulation control and clinical outcomes. | Thus we sought to review the available medical literature systematically examining the effectiveness of low-dose vitamin K supplementation for the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events due to vitamin K antagonist (VKA) use and for stabilization of the international normalized ratio (INR). | We evaluated the outcomes of hemorrhage, thromboembolic events, and percentage of time in therapeutic range (TTR) of INRs by using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation system for rating quality of evidence in the abstracted studies.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis, despite the few studies and overall low quality, suggests no beneficial role of low-dose (100 to 200 μg) vitamin K supplementation on the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events in patients taking VKAs, despite a small improvement of the TTR.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 메타분석은 포함된 연구가 적고 전반적 질이 낮음에도, 치료범위내시간(TTR)의 소폭 개선에도 불구하고 비타민 K 길항제를 복용하는 환자에서 저용량(100 to 200 μg) 비타민 K 보충이 임상적으로 유의한 이상반응 감소에 유익한 역할을 하지 않음을 시사한다.
evidence.population: STUDY OBJECTIVES: Difficulties managing warfarin therapy have led to speculation that daily supplementation with a low dose of vitamin K might improve anticoagulation control and clinical outcomes.

evidence.title: Effect of vitamin E supplementation on vitamin K status in adults with normal coagulation status.
evidence.authors: Booth SL; Golly I; Sacheck JM; Roubenoff R; Dallal GE; Hamada K; Blumberg JB
evidence.venue: The American journal of clinical nutrition
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: CONCLUSIONS: High-dose vitamin E supplementation increased PIVKA-II in adults not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Cases of enhanced anticoagulant effect in response to high-dose vitamin E supplementation have been reported among patients taking oral anticoagulants. | Although a vitamin E-vitamin K interaction was proposed to underlie this effect, it has not been systematically investigated in adults with normal baseline coagulation status. | OBJECTIVE: The objective was to study the effect of 12 wk of supplementation with 1000 IU RRR-alpha-tocopherol/d on biochemical measures of vitamin K status in men and women not taking oral anticoagulants.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: High-dose vitamin E supplementation increased PIVKA-II in adults not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 고용량 비타민 E 보충은 경구 항응고요법을 받지 않는 성인에서 PIVKA-II를 증가시켰다.
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Research Support, U.S. Gov't, Non-P.H.S.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Cases of enhanced anticoagulant effect in response to high-dose vitamin E supplementation have been reported among patients taking oral anticoagulants. | OBJECTIVE: The objective was to study the effect of 12 wk of supplementation with 1000 IU RRR-alpha-tocopherol/d on biochemical measures of vitamin K status in men and women not taking oral anticoagulants. | CONCLUSIONS: High-dose vitamin E supplementation increased PIVKA-II in adults not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy.

evidence.title: Brief communication: American ginseng reduces warfarin's effect in healthy patients: a randomized, controlled Trial.
evidence.authors: Yuan CS; Wei G; Dey L; Karrison T; Nahlik L; Maleckar S; Kasza K; Ang-Lee M; Moss J
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: RESULTS: The peak INR statistically significantly decreased after 2 weeks of ginseng administration compared with placebo (difference between ginseng and placebo, -0.19 [95% CI, -0.36 to -0.07]; P = 0.0012).
evidence.outcome: In a case report, the anticoagulant effect of warfarin decreased after patients consumed ginseng. | OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the interactions between American ginseng and warfarin. | MEASUREMENTS: International normalized ratio (INR) and plasma warfarin level.
evidence.key_finding: RESULTS: The peak INR statistically significantly decreased after 2 weeks of ginseng administration compared with placebo (difference between ginseng and placebo, -0.19 [95% CI, -0.36 to -0.07]; P = 0.0012).
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과: 최고 INR은 위약과 비교해 인삼 투여 2주 후 통계적으로 유의하게 감소했다(인삼과 위약의 차이, -0.19 [95% CI, -0.36 to -0.07]; P = 0.0012).
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Research Support, U.S. Gov't, P.H.S.
evidence.population: In a case report, the anticoagulant effect of warfarin decreased after patients consumed ginseng. | OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the interactions between American ginseng and warfarin. | INTERVENTION: In this 4-week study, 20 patients received warfarin for 3 days during weeks 1 and 4.

all_evidence.title: Interactions between herbal medicines and prescribed drugs: a systematic review.
all_evidence.authors: Izzo AA; Ernst E
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: The results indicate that St John's wort (Hypericum perforatum) lowers blood concentrations of cyclosporin, amitriptyline, digoxin, indinavir, warfarin, phenprocoumon and theophylline; furthermore it causes intermenstrual bleeding, delirium or mild serotonin syndrome, respectively, when used concomitantly with oral contraceptives (ethinylestradiol/desogestrel), loperamide or selective serotonin-reuptake inhibitors (sertaline, paroxetine, nefazodone).
all_evidence.outcome: Despite the widespread use of herbal medicines, documented herb-drug interactions are sparse. | We have reviewed the literature to determine the possible interactions between the seven top-selling herbal medicines (ginkgo, St John's wort, ginseng, garlic, echinacea, saw palmetto and kava) and prescribed drugs. | All data relating to herb-drug interactions were included regardless of whether they were based on case reports, case series, clinical trials or other types of investigation in humans.
all_evidence.key_finding: The results indicate that St John's wort (Hypericum perforatum) lowers blood concentrations of cyclosporin, amitriptyline, digoxin, indinavir, warfarin, phenprocoumon and theophylline; furthermore it causes intermenstrual bleeding, delirium or mild serotonin syndrome, respectively, when used concomitantly with oral contraceptives (ethinylestradiol/desogestrel), loperamide or selective serotonin-reuptake inhibitors (sertaline, paroxetine, nefazodone).
all_evidence.key_finding_ko: 결과에 따르면 세인트존스워트(Hypericum perforatum)는 사이클로스포린, 아미트립틸린, 디곡신, 인디나비르, 와파린, 펜프로쿠몬, 테오필린의 혈중 농도를 낮춘다. 또한 경구피임약(에티닐에스트라디올/데소게스트렐), 로페라마이드, 선택적 세로토닌 재흡수 억제제(설트랄린, 파록세틴, 네파조돈)와 병용했을 때 각각 월경간 출혈, 섬망, 경증 세로토닌 증후군을 일으킨다.
all_evidence.population: The results indicate that St John's wort (Hypericum perforatum) lowers blood concentrations of cyclosporin, amitriptyline, digoxin, indinavir, warfarin, phenprocoumon and theophylline; furthermore it causes intermenstrual bleeding, delirium or mild serotonin syndrome, respectively, when used concomitantly with oral contraceptives (ethinylestradiol/desogestrel), loperamide or selective serotonin-reuptake inhibitors (sertaline, paroxetine, nefazodone). | Ginkgo (Ginkgo biloba) interactions include bleeding when combined with warfarin, raised blood pressure when combined with a thiazide diuretic and coma when combined with trazodone. | Ginseng (Panax ginseng) lowers blood concentrations of alcohol and warfarin, and induces mania if used concomitantly with phenelzine.

all_evidence.title: Interactions of commonly used dietary supplements with cardiovascular drugs: a systematic review.
all_evidence.authors: Kanji S; Seely D; Yazdi F; Tetzlaff J; Singh K; Tsertsvadze A; Tricco AC; Sears ME; Ooi TC; Turek MA; Skidmore B; Ansari MT
all_evidence.locator:
ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: Incremental benefits were noted for triglyceridemia with omega-3 fatty acid added to statins; and there was an improvement in levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol with garlic supplementation when people also consumed nitrates
CONCLUSIONS: Evidence of low-strength indicates benefits of omega-3 fatty acids (plus statin, or calcium channel blockers and antiplatelets) and garlic (plus nitrates or warfarin) on triglycerides and HDL-C, respectively.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: The objective of this systematic review was to examine the benefits, harms and pharmacokinetic interactions arising from the co-administration of commonly used dietary supplements with cardiovascular drugs. | Many patients on cardiovascular drugs take dietary supplements for presumed benefits and may be at risk for adverse supplement-drug interactions. | With only a few small studies available per supplement, evidence was insufficient for all predefined gradable clinical efficacy and harms outcomes, such as mortality and serious adverse events.
all_evidence.key_finding:
Incremental benefits were noted for triglyceridemia with omega-3 fatty acid added to statins; and there was an improvement in levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol with garlic supplementation when people also consumed nitrates
CONCLUSIONS: Evidence of low-strength indicates benefits of omega-3 fatty acids (plus statin, or calcium channel blockers and antiplatelets) and garlic (plus nitrates or warfarin) on triglycerides and HDL-C, respectively.
all_evidence.key_finding_ko:
스타틴에 오메가-3 지방산을 추가했을 때 중성지방혈증에서 추가적 이득이 관찰됐고, 질산염을 함께 복용한 사람에서 마늘 보충 시 고밀도지단백 콜레스테롤 수치가 개선됐다.
결론: 낮은 강도의 근거는 오메가-3 지방산(스타틴 또는 칼슘통로차단제·항혈소판제 병용)이 중성지방에, 마늘(질산염 또는 와파린 병용)이 HDL-C에 각각 이득이 있음을 시사한다.
all_evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Systematic Review

CONCLUSIONS: Evidence of low-strength indicates benefits of omega-3 fatty acids (plus statin, or calcium channel blockers and antiplatelets) and garlic (plus nitrates or warfarin) on triglycerides and HDL-C, respectively.

evidence.title: Interactions of commonly used dietary supplements with cardiovascular drugs: a systematic review.
evidence.authors: Kanji S; Seely D; Yazdi F; Tetzlaff J; Singh K; Tsertsvadze A; Tricco AC; Sears ME; Ooi TC; Turek MA; Skidmore B; Ansari MT
evidence.locator:
ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_10: Incremental benefits were noted for triglyceridemia with omega-3 fatty acid added to statins; and there was an improvement in levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol with garlic supplementation when people also consumed nitrates
CONCLUSIONS: Evidence of low-strength indicates benefits of omega-3 fatty acids (plus statin, or calcium channel blockers and antiplatelets) and garlic (plus nitrates or warfarin) on triglycerides and HDL-C, respectively.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: The objective of this systematic review was to examine the benefits, harms and pharmacokinetic interactions arising from the co-administration of commonly used dietary supplements with cardiovascular drugs. | Many patients on cardiovascular drugs take dietary supplements for presumed benefits and may be at risk for adverse supplement-drug interactions. | With only a few small studies available per supplement, evidence was insufficient for all predefined gradable clinical efficacy and harms outcomes, such as mortality and serious adverse events.
evidence.key_finding:
Incremental benefits were noted for triglyceridemia with omega-3 fatty acid added to statins; and there was an improvement in levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol with garlic supplementation when people also consumed nitrates
CONCLUSIONS: Evidence of low-strength indicates benefits of omega-3 fatty acids (plus statin, or calcium channel blockers and antiplatelets) and garlic (plus nitrates or warfarin) on triglycerides and HDL-C, respectively.
evidence.key_finding_ko:
스타틴에 오메가-3 지방산을 추가했을 때 중성지방혈증에서 추가적 이득이 관찰됐고, 질산염을 함께 복용한 사람에서 마늘 보충 시 고밀도지단백 콜레스테롤 수치가 개선됐다.
결론: 낮은 강도의 근거는 오메가-3 지방산(스타틴 또는 칼슘통로차단제·항혈소판제 병용)이 중성지방에, 마늘(질산염 또는 와파린 병용)이 HDL-C에 각각 이득이 있음을 시사한다.
evidence.publication_types: Journal Article|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Systematic Review
evidence.population:
Incremental benefits were noted for triglyceridemia with omega-3 fatty acid added to statins; and there was an improvement in levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol with garlic supplementation when people also consumed nitrates
CONCLUSIONS: Evidence of low-strength indicates benefits of omega-3 fatty acids (plus statin, or calcium channel blockers and antiplatelets) and garlic (plus nitrates or warfarin) on triglycerides and HDL-C, respectively.

evidence.title: Anticoagulation control with daily low-dose vitamin k to reduce clinically adverse outcomes and international normalized ratio variability: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
evidence.authors: Lam J; Schulman S; Witt DM; Vandvik PO; Qayyum F; Holbrook AM
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_11: CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis, despite the few studies and overall low quality, suggests no beneficial role of low-dose (100 to 200 μg) vitamin K supplementation on the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events in patients taking VKAs, despite a small improvement of the TTR.
evidence.outcome: STUDY OBJECTIVES: Difficulties managing warfarin therapy have led to speculation that daily supplementation with a low dose of vitamin K might improve anticoagulation control and clinical outcomes. | Thus we sought to review the available medical literature systematically examining the effectiveness of low-dose vitamin K supplementation for the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events due to vitamin K antagonist (VKA) use and for stabilization of the international normalized ratio (INR). | We evaluated the outcomes of hemorrhage, thromboembolic events, and percentage of time in therapeutic range (TTR) of INRs by using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation system for rating quality of evidence in the abstracted studies.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis, despite the few studies and overall low quality, suggests no beneficial role of low-dose (100 to 200 μg) vitamin K supplementation on the reduction of clinically relevant adverse events in patients taking VKAs, despite a small improvement of the TTR.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 이 메타분석은 포함된 연구가 적고 전반적 질이 낮음에도, 치료범위내시간(TTR)의 소폭 개선에도 불구하고 비타민 K 길항제를 복용하는 환자에서 저용량(100 to 200 μg) 비타민 K 보충이 임상적으로 유의한 이상반응 감소에 유익한 역할을 하지 않음을 시사한다.
evidence.population: STUDY OBJECTIVES: Difficulties managing warfarin therapy have led to speculation that daily supplementation with a low dose of vitamin K might improve anticoagulation control and clinical outcomes.

evidence.title: Effect of vitamin E supplementation on vitamin K status in adults with normal coagulation status.
evidence.authors: Booth SL; Golly I; Sacheck JM; Roubenoff R; Dallal GE; Hamada K; Blumberg JB
evidence.venue: The American journal of clinical nutrition
evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: CONCLUSIONS: High-dose vitamin E supplementation increased PIVKA-II in adults not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy.
evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Cases of enhanced anticoagulant effect in response to high-dose vitamin E supplementation have been reported among patients taking oral anticoagulants. | Although a vitamin E-vitamin K interaction was proposed to underlie this effect, it has not been systematically investigated in adults with normal baseline coagulation status. | OBJECTIVE: The objective was to study the effect of 12 wk of supplementation with 1000 IU RRR-alpha-tocopherol/d on biochemical measures of vitamin K status in men and women not taking oral anticoagulants.
evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSIONS: High-dose vitamin E supplementation increased PIVKA-II in adults not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy.
evidence.key_finding_ko: 결론: 고용량 비타민 E 보충은 경구 항응고요법을 받지 않는 성인에서 PIVKA-II를 증가시켰다.
evidence.publication_types: Clinical Trial|Journal Article|Randomized Controlled Trial|Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't|Research Support, U.S. Gov't, Non-P.H.S.
evidence.population: BACKGROUND: Cases of enhanced anticoagulant effect in response to high-dose vitamin E supplementation have been reported among patients taking oral anticoagulants. | OBJECTIVE: The objective was to study the effect of 12 wk of supplementation with 1000 IU RRR-alpha-tocopherol/d on biochemical measures of vitamin K status in men and women not taking oral anticoagulants. | CONCLUSIONS: High-dose vitamin E supplementation increased PIVKA-II in adults not receiving oral anticoagulant therapy.

all_evidence.title: Interactions between herbal medicines and prescribed drugs: a systematic review.
all_evidence.authors: Izzo AA; Ernst E
all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: The results indicate that St John's wort (Hypericum perforatum) lowers blood concentrations of cyclosporin, amitriptyline, digoxin, indinavir, warfarin, phenprocoumon and theophylline; furthermore it causes intermenstrual bleeding, delirium or mild serotonin syndrome, respectively, when used concomitantly with oral contraceptives (ethinylestradiol/desogestrel), loperamide or selective serotonin-reuptake inhibitors (sertaline, paroxetine, nefazodone).
all_evidence.outcome: Despite the widespread use of herbal medicines, documented herb-drug interactions are sparse. | We have reviewed the literature to determine the possible interactions between the seven top-selling herbal medicines (ginkgo, St John's wort, ginseng, garlic, echinacea, saw palmetto and kava) and prescribed drugs. | All data relating to herb-drug interactions were included regardless of whether they were based on case reports, case series, clinical trials or other types of investigation in humans.

all_evidence.title: Omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid exposure and cardiovascular outcomes in dialysis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

all_evidence.locator: ABSTRACT_SENTENCE_8: CONCLUSION: In dialysis-dependent CKD, higher n-3 PUFA exposure through fish oil supplementation or higher baseline levels was associated with fewer cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality.
all_evidence.outcome: BACKGROUND: Patients with dialysis-dependent chronic kidney disease (CKD) have a high cardiovascular burden, prompting interest in fish oils or long-chain omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (n-3 PUFAs) as potential risk-reducing therapies in this population. | METHODS: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of studies in adults receiving dialysis that assessed associations between n-3 PUFA supplementation, baseline levels, or dietary intake and CV outcomes, or all-cause mortality. | In hemodialysis-dependent CKD, fish oil supplementation lowered cardiovascular events by 44% (HR 0.56; 95% CI 0.46-0.68) and myocardial infarction by 48% (HR 0.52; 95% CI 0.34-0.78).
all_evidence.key_finding: CONCLUSION: In dialysis-dependent CKD, higher n-3 PUFA exposure through fish oil supplementation or higher baseline levels was associated with fewer cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality.
